title: Per-customer & per-route segmentation curator for safe batching and cache recommendations
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create a service (Segmentation Curator) that automatically proposes per-customer and per-route optimization policies (batching, KV-prefix caching, quantization profile hints) and can safely apply them via a dry-run/canary/rollback workflow. The curator must integrate with policy simulation, the Console recommendations UI, and the policy orchestration engine so that policy changes are observable, reversible, and gated by customer-facing SLO checks.
acceptance_criteria: Curator generates per-route recommendations and stores them as policy drafts in policy-store (JSON diff) with provenance metadata
Dry-run simulation can run against historical telemetry and produce estimated cost/latency delta and risk score
Safe-apply flow supports: staged canary (1%, 10%, 100%), automated rollback when latency or correctness regressions exceed thresholds, and manual abort
Console surfaces recommendations with rationale and one-click apply to create an orchestrated rollout plan
End-to-end tests validate rollback is executed within 60s of threshold breach and no more than 2% traffic remains on changed config after rollback completes
tasks: Design API for recommendation output (policy draft schema + rationale fields)
Implement simulation runner that replays recent traces + synthetic requests to estimate impact
Build canary controller that hooks into traffic router and rollout engine
Integrate with telemetry to measure token-level cost, per-route latency P50/P95 and inference correctness signals
Add Console UI card for curator recommendations with explainability text and action buttons
Author runbook for operators for inspecting a rollback and forcing remediation
End-to-end integration tests and load test to validate safe-apply under 50k RPS
tech_notes: Recommendation engine will use segmentation keys: customer_id, route_id, model_variant, seq_len_bucket
Risk score = weighted(sum(latency_regression_prob, correctness_delta, cache_eviction_risk, customer_tier_weight))
Simulation uses cached KV states and model-instrumented latency models to avoid hitting production model endpoints
Fall-back plan: if simulation cannot reach confidence threshold, recommendation is marked advisory only
Policy drafts will include revert_patch to allow atomic rollback via the same orchestration API
rollout_plan: Create draft recommendation (no traffic) and store in policy-store
Dry-run simulation against last 72h of telemetry; produce estimated cost savings and risk score
If risk_score <= 0.15 and projected_latency_delta < 5ms P95, schedule canary: 1% traffic for 30m
Monitor SLOs and correctness checks; if stable, escalate to 10% for 1h then 100% for 2h
If any threshold triggered, orchestrator will execute revert_patch and send alerts to #runbooks and owner
Post-rollout: 24h automatic evaluation and RM report generation
test_plan: Unit tests for policy draft generation and diff/revert patch creation
Integration tests for simulation runner using recorded traces and golden-replay harness
Chaos test: inject latency/noise during canary and assert rollback triggers
Load test: drive 50k RPS through canary controller while simulating cache-hit rate changes
E2E human-in-the-loop test with Console applying a recommendation
blockers: Policy-store schema 2.0 is in review (PR: github.com/redwood/repo/pull/4128)
Telemetry retention for per-tenant traces currently 7 days; need 30 days for better simulation accuracy
Need a Console design iteration for the recommendation card (Design review scheduled)
decisions: Use a scoring-first approach: only recommend auto-apply for low-risk (score <= 0.10) and medium-risk as advisory
Simulations will be deterministic replays with adjusted latency model vs live probing to avoid model-cost blowup
Don’t enable auto-apply for customers in enterprise tier without explicit opt-in
Rollback will prefer policy patch revert over emergency route split to minimize blast radius
